description:
The 4StoreyBuilding project is open in eQUEST. You need to implement a lighting control retrofit for the Top Floor. For ALL five Top Floor spaces (T.S31, T.E32, T.N33, T.W34, T.C35), configure the Lighting Control system to use 'Occupancy Sensor' with 90% of the area fitted. 

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Building Shell component tree.
2. Locate the Top Floor spaces (starting with 'T.').
3. For each of the 5 spaces, go to the 'Daylighting' or 'Lighting Control' settings (often found within Space Properties).
4. Set 'Control Method 1' (LIGHT-CTRL-TYPE1) to 'Occupancy Sensor'.
5. Set '% Area Fitted 1' (LIGHT-CTRL-PROB1) to 0.9 (representing 90%).
6. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation.
7. Save the project.

Note: You must modify all 5 spaces on the top floor. Do not modify Daylighting controls (dimming), only Lighting Controls (switching/sensors).
